title: LibreNMS Helm Chart Values
description: Schema for LibreNMS Helm Chart values.yaml configuration

valueFrom.description: Source for the environment variable's value

envFromSource.description: Kubernetes envFrom source (ConfigMap or Secret reference)

optional.description: Whether the ConfigMap must be defined
Whether the Secret must be defined

securityContext.description: Security context settings for init container

appkey.description: Laravel APP_KEY for encryption. If blank, a random 32-character key will be auto-generated. Format: base64:...

existingSecret.description: Existing secret name to use for appkey

configuration.description: Custom configuration options for LibreNMS (PHP code)

extraEnvs.description: Extra environment variables applied to all LibreNMS components

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources applied to all LibreNMS components

privileged.description: Global setting to run components as privileged

appUrl.description: Externally visible base URL of this instance, including scheme

appTrustedProxies.description: Proxy IPs/CIDRs (or "*") whose X-Forwarded-* headers Laravel should trust

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for frontend containers

extraEnvs.description: Extra environment variables for frontend containers

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources for frontend containers

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for poller containers

extraEnvs.description: Extra environment variables for poller containers

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources for poller containers

podAnnotations.description: Pod annotations for SNMP scanner pods

securityContext.description: Security context for SNMP scanner pod

allOf.description: Computing resources for SNMP scanner containers

extraEnvs.description: Extra environment variables for SNMP scanner containers

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources for SNMP scanner containers

extraEnvs.description: Extra environment variables for RRDCached containers

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources for RRDCached containers

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for rrdcached containers

type.description: Service type for the syslog receiver

loadBalancerIP.description: Static IP to request when type is LoadBalancer

externalTrafficPolicy.description: externalTrafficPolicy for the service, set to Local to preserve the source IP of incoming messages

extraEnvs.description: Extra environment variables for syslogng containers

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources for syslogng containers

community.description: SNMP v1/v2c community string devices must send their traps with

processingType.description: snmptrapd processing types (log, execute and/or net) applied to accepted traps

disableAuthorization.description: Accept traps without checking the community string or SNMPv3 user

extraMibDirs.description: Additional colon-separated MIB directories to load

snmpv3.description: SNMPv3 credentials used to authenticate traps

existingSecret.description: Existing secret holding the SNMPv3 passwords

name.description: Name of the secret holding the SNMPv3 passwords

authKey.description: Key in the secret containing the authentication password

privKey.description: Key in the secret containing the privacy password

type.description: Service type for the trap receiver

loadBalancerIP.description: Static IP to request when type is LoadBalancer

externalTrafficPolicy.description: externalTrafficPolicy for the service, set to Local to preserve the trap source IP

allOf.description: Computing resources for the snmptrapd container

extraEnvs.description: Extra environment variables for snmptrapd containers

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources for snmptrapd containers

gateway.description: Gateway API HTTPRoute configuration for the frontend

parentRefs.description: Gateways this route attaches to, required when enabled

group.description: API group of the parent, defaults to gateway.networking.k8s.io

kind.description: Kind of the parent, defaults to Gateway

namespace.description: Namespace of the Gateway, defaults to the release namespace

sectionName.description: Name of the Gateway listener to attach to

port.description: Port of the Gateway listener to attach to

paths.description: Path matches, each becoming an HTTPRoute rule backed by the frontend service

externalRedis.description: External Redis configuration. Used when redis.enabled is false.

host.description: Redis host (DNS name or IP address). Blank disables Redis and falls back to the file cache and session drivers.

externalDatabase.description: External database configuration. Used when mysql.enabled is false.

host.description: Database host (DNS name or IP address). Supports both 'hostname' or 'hostname:port' formats. If port is included in the host field, it takes precedence over the separate port field.

port.description: Database port. Optional if port is included in the host field.

existingSecret.description: Reference to existing secret containing database password

key.description: Key in the secret containing the password

password.description: Database password (plain text, not recommended for production)

mysql.description: Configuration for MySQL dependency chart by HelmForge (https://github.com/helmforgedev/charts/tree/main/charts/mysql). Additional properties are passed through to the subchart.

enabled.description: Enable bundled MySQL subchart. Set to false to use externalDatabase instead.

oneOf.description: Use an existing secret for MySQL authentication. Useful when migrating from the Bitnami MySQL subchart, which created a secret named 'RELEASE-mysql' with key 'mysql-password'.

name.description: Name of the existing secret containing the MySQL password

key.description: Key in the secret containing the MySQL password

oneOf.description: Empty object disables the override (default behavior)
